items.title: Health Ministry’s Nursing Vacancies Rise, Now Exceed 15,000
items.summary: Nursing vacancies in MOH rose from 14,792 in Sept 2025 to 15,587 in March 2026, marking an increase of 795 vacancies. MOH also reported 2,901 vacancies for AMOs in March 2026.
